title: Gamebook
description: A choose-your-path gamebook: numbered/keyed sections, choices, player stats, inventory, flags, dice tests, light combat, multiple-choice riddles, NPC characters, collection trackers and endings. Text fields may contain the token {{name}}, which the reader replaces with the player's name.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the book was written for.

stats.description: Player stat definitions keyed by stat id.

flags.description: Optional declaration of story flags (documentation + initial values). Undeclared flags start as false.

items.description: Catalog of every item that can appear in the inventory, keyed by item id.

statusEffects.description: Timed status effects (e.g. poison) by id.

startingInventory.description: Items the player starts with. A bare string means quantity 1.

sections.description: All sections (pages/paragraphs) keyed by id. Ids can be numbers-as-strings ("1", "237") like classic gamebooks, or readable slugs.

characters.description: Non-player characters (NPCs) keyed by id. Their pixel sprites can be placed on illustrations and shown in riddle encounters.

trackers.description: Optional collections shown on the journey panel and the end scorecard, e.g. a Zodiac Collection. An entry counts as found when its flag is true.

completeBadge.description: Badge shown on the ending card when every entry is found.

character.description: Character whose sprite represents this entry.

scoring.description: Final SCORE shown on winning endings. Each component is value × points; the total is shown as a percentage of `reference`, the best total any path can reach (compute it with scripts/score-reference.mjs), so the optimal path scores exactly 100%.

tracker.description: Count entries found in this tracker.

items.description: Count distinct items ever picked up (found) or used up / handed over (used).

oneOf.description: Reference that depends on a stat rolled at the start (e.g. Luck), so every starting roll can still reach 100%.

riddlePool.description: Relative path (from the book file) to a riddle pool JSON file (schema/riddles.schema.json). Riddle encounters with "draw" pick their questions from it at random, with no repeats within one game.

diceFormula.description: Dice notation: NdS with optional +/- modifier, e.g. "1d6+6", "2d6", "2d6-1". "1d2" is a coin flip.

richText.description: A string, or an array of paragraphs. A paragraph can be {"text", "if"}: it is only shown when the condition is true.

pixelSprite.description: Tiny pixel-art image: each row is a string, each character is a key into palette ('.' or ' ' = transparent).

id.description: Stable id, used as the save-game key.

original.description: True when the text is original work (not taken from a published book).

source.description: Provenance if the book is an adaptation of an existing work.

permission.description: Reference to the permission/licence that allows this use.

healthStat.description: Stat that represents health/energy (used as the default combat health).

onHealthDepleted.description: Older shorthand: same as a depletion rule for healthStat.

combat.description: Defaults for combat encounters (Fighting-Fantasy-like: each round both sides roll dice + attack stat; the lower total loses damage points).

depletion.description: Death/defeat rules checked after EVERY change (section entry, choice, dice test, combat round, item use). The first rule whose stat is at or below its limit sends the player to its target section, usually an ending.

atOrBelow.description: Trigger value; defaults to the stat's min (usually 0).

perMoveEffects.description: Applied automatically on EVERY move (each time the player goes to a new section by a choice, dice test, fight, riddle or retreat; not at the start). Example: [{"stat":"power","add":-1}] turns Pixel Power into a move timer. Depletion rules are checked right after.

bonusStars.description: Cosmetic bonus stars: every won luck roll (a passed luck test with againstStat, or a won dice gamble) earns +1 star. Shown in the HUD, on the ending and in the Best Scores table; never part of the score, cannot be spent and changes no stat.

initial.description: Starting value: a fixed number or a dice roll made once at the start.

max.description: Upper bound. "initial" caps the stat at its rolled starting value (Fighting Fantasy style).

icon.description: Emoji or short text shown next to the stat.

display.description: bar = filled bar against max; number = just the value; timer = countdown bar measured against the starting value (it can go above via bonuses) that flashes when low.

sprite.description: Pixel icon drawn instead of the emoji icon (e.g. a coin for tokens).

stackable.description: Can be held in quantity > 1 (coins, tokens, provisions).

use.description: Makes the item usable from the inventory at any time (e.g. eat provisions).

equals.description: Value the flag must have (default true).

status.description: True while this timed status effect (statusEffects) is active, e.g. poisoned.

effect.description: A change to the game state.

restore.description: Reset the stat to its maximum.

multiply.description: Multiply the CURRENT value, e.g. 0.5 halves it, 2 doubles it (then clamped to min/max).

halve.description: Shorthand for multiply 0.5 with round down: 9 → 4, 1 → 0.

oneOf.description: Change a stat: add, set, restore to max, multiply (e.g. 0.5) or halve (round down).

lost.description: Taken away (e.g. eaten by PiGeons) rather than used by the player: it does not count as an item used for the score.

bonusStar.description: Award cosmetic bonus stars (needs rules.bonusStars). Never a stat, never scored.

addStatus.description: Start a timed status effect from statusEffects (e.g. poison). Catching it again restarts the countdown; it never stacks.

moves.description: How many moves it lasts (default: the status effect's moves).

cureStatus.description: End a timed status effect now (e.g. a cure for poison). Does nothing if it isn't active.

hideIfLocked.description: Hide the choice entirely when conditions fail (otherwise shown as locked).

hideIf.description: Hide the choice entirely when this condition is true (e.g. you already own the item it would give).

lockedHint.description: Shown on a locked choice, e.g. 'Needs: Brass Key'.

effects.description: Applied when the choice is taken, before entering the target.

diceTest.description: Roll dice and branch. Luck test: success if total <= the stat ('againstStat'). Target test: total >= 'target'. Dice gamble ('type': 'gamble', used for every bet in the story; affects only 'stat', default Luck): roll 2d6 (dice); total >= winAt (default 8) = success (the prize); exactly halfOn (default 7) = 'stat' is halved (round down) and the 'seven' outcome is used; anything lower = 'stat' -loseBy (default 2) and the failure outcome. Stakes are paid by the choice leading here. The reader shows the odds before rolling.

addStat.description: With 'target': add this stat to the roll.

type.description: Optional; 'gamble' switches to the dice-gamble rule.

winAt.description: Gamble: roll this or more to win (default 8).

halfOn.description: Gamble: rolling exactly this halves halfStat (default 7).

seven.description: Gamble: what happens on exactly halfOn, after halving 'stat'. A missing target/text comes from 'failure'; failure effects are not applied.

stat.description: Gamble: the only stat a gamble changes (default luck).

loseBy.description: Gamble: how much of 'stat' a lost roll costs (default 2).

damage.description: Energy lost per enemy bop (default: the combat damage). Armor from boosts lowers it, never below 1.
Damage the player deals per bop (and the enemy too, unless the enemy sets its own damage).

loseAt.description: Combat is lost when the player's health stat drops to this value or below.

boosts.description: Edges a well-prepared player earns, listed on the fight screen. Each active boost adds attack to the player roll total, armor (enemy bops hurt that much less, minimum 1), stun (the first enemy starts with that much less HP, minimum 1) and/or a display-only note.

tracker.description: Active only when at least min entries of this tracker are met.

stun.description: HP taken off the first enemy when the fight starts.

note.description: Shown instead of a number, for an advantage applied by the story before the fight.

type.description: death = classic gamebook 'your adventure ends here'.

style.description: Presentation. "trapped" = dramatic arcade GAME OVER screen with the player's avatar stuck inside the machine and a CONTINUE countdown.

cause.description: The stat this ending blames (e.g. "power"). On entering, the stat is set to its minimum (0), so the stats panel matches why you lost, and the trapped screen says YOUR <STAT> RAN OUT.

characters.description: Character sprites drawn on top of the picture. x/y are in picture pixels on the grid below (default 96×54, the size of the bundled scenes).

onEnter.description: Applied once each time the section is entered.

riddle.description: A multiple-choice riddle encounter, with fixed questions or drawn at random from the riddle pool (draw). Before answering each question the player may RETREAT (no cost, but the encounter's success is missed). A correct answer applies onCorrect. A wrong answer makes the player pick one of wrong.options (e.g. pay 2 tokens OR halve Energy); locked options can't be picked. After the last question, success is applied.

onCorrect.description: Applied after each correct answer (e.g. +1 token).

draw.description: Ask this many riddles drawn at random from the book's riddlePool instead of fixed questions. The draw is seeded and stored in the save, so reloading doesn't change the riddle, and a riddle never repeats within one game.

untilCorrect.description: With 'draw': after a wrong answer (and its penalty) the same character asks another random, never-asked pool riddle, until 'draw' riddles are answered correctly. Retreat stays available before every new riddle.

statusDef.description: A timed status effect: while active, its perMove effects run on every move (after rules.perMoveEffects) and it counts down by one; at 0 it wears off. If a tick empties a death stat, the normal depletion ending follows. Saved with the game (state.status).

badge.description: Short label for the stats-panel badge, shown with the moves left, e.g. POISONED → "POISONED x5".
